verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents an official CLI on its own developer-tools reference page (livekit-cli). It scaffolds agents, runs them locally and deploys them to LiveKit Cloud. The GitHub README adds server API access, token creation and test-traffic generation. missing for 10: evidence of AI-native CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output or coding-agent integration through the CLI), installation/command reference detail, independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Scaffold an agent, talk to it locally, and deploy it to LiveKit Cloud:
server APIs, create tokens, generate test traffic, and scaffold and deploy agents.
